title: Pending journal entries
summary: From bank file to posted ledger, step by step.

paragraphs.text: Pending is the inbox between your bank and your books. Import a file, review each row, assign accounts so debits and credits make sense, then Apply when you are ready.
Dates tie into period rules—if apply fails, often it is because a transaction sits in a closed period or before your oldest open period. Fix the date or clear pending in that range before you close.
